description: Harnesses (H1, H2…) are assemblies you make and someone builds: a tag, a name, a part number and the loose wires and cables built into them. They print (tagged trunk, drawing sheet, breakout table, BOM line) and their current-carrying conductors, cables' included, count together to derate ampacity. Create one (omit harness, give a new H tag, or from_bundle to start from a bundle's wires), add or remove wires (ids from get_project) and cables (tags), retag, name it, set its part number, draw it as a trunk or as separate wires (everywhere or in one view), or delete it (its wires and cables stay). A wire or cable is in one harness at most: adding it moves it. A cable conductor id stands for its cable.

add_cables.description: Cable tags or ids to put in it

add_wires.description: Wire ids to put in it

from_bundle.description: Bundle tag (B1) or key from get_project: its wires go into the harness (a new one unless harness names one).

harness.description: Harness tag (H1) or name. Omit, or give a tag no harness has, to create one.

part_number.description: Part or drawing number of the built harness, for the BOM and its drawing sheet. null clears it.

show.description: One trunk or separate wires, in every view.

view.description: Subsystem name or id for view_show; null = the top-level view.

view_show.description: Trunk or separate wires in that view; null goes back to `show`.

name: update_harness
title: Update harness
